thread:
Tom R: Planning sync: we need a differential rollout plan that respects SLA-bound customers and gives us fast signal on regressions. Thoughts on cohorts + circuit breakers?
Yvonne: I'd do a two-axis rollout: exposure by tenant tier (alpha/beta/general) and by SLA class (standard/enterprise). Start alpha-enterprise -> alpha-standard -> beta -> general. Keeps big customers in small cohorts early.
Kai: Technical constraints: route-v2 requires a small schema change in headers for tracing. We'll ship a compatibility shim so old clients still get v1. Also need per-tenant opt-out flags and a routing-layer circuit breaker that trips at shard-level.
Tom R: Telemetry gating: short window checks (10m) for infra signals and longer windows (3h) for quality. Short alarms: 5xx absolute > 0.35% or queue depth > 50% of capacity. Long gates: p95 up > 20% or quality delta > 1.0% on eval set.
Yvonne: For experiments: recommend a 5% randomized A/B holdback per region with session-level stickiness. Shadowing detailed logs for 48h. We'll compute per-prompt diffs and surface top-20 regressions.
Kai: Routing fallback policy: priority list -> (1) model-variant fallback v2-eco, (2) region-wide fallback to v1, (3) tenant-level opt-out. Each fallback has a throttle: do not fallback more than 10% of traffic in 60s to avoid cascade.
release-bot: rollout-scheduler: routing-service:v2 scheduled 2026-09-12T20:00Z for alpha-enterprise cohort. Monitor: #eng-oncall.
Tom R: CI smoke test must emulate a 5xx spike pattern and verify circuit breaker opens and route fallback happens within 30s. Add a test that asserts no more than 5% user-visible failures during fallback.
Yvonne: Communication plan: 72h notice for enterprise tenants, with an opt-out link and a short KB describing rollback path. For any tenant tagged "strict-sla" require account manager sign-off before >10% exposure.
Kai: Instrumentation ask: emit metric 'routing.v2.fallback.reason' with labels {region,tenant,reason} so we can alert on patterns, not just counts. Dashboards should show per-tenant small-multiple views.
Tom R: Decision matrix for go/no-go after each ramp:
- Proceed if short-window infra gates clear AND sampled quality diff < 0.8%
- Pause and investigate if short-window infra gates fail
- Roll back if long-window quality delta >1.5% or enterprise tickets spike
Yvonne: Owners: Tom = PM owner & comms, Kai = infra & fallbacks, Yvonne = metrics & experiment analysis, CS = customer notice + opt-outs. Can we lock this by EOD?
CS: We'll prepare the targeted email template and the opt-out flow. Also will keep a list of tenants that must be contacted by phone.
Tom R: One more: include a post-deploy validation smoke that runs a set of 100 golden prompts and fails the rollout if new hallucination patterns cross threshold. Who picks this up?
Kai: I'll add it to the gating tests and wire failure to the flag toggle.
Yvonne: I'll build the observability dashboard and add an alert that pings #product on regression. Add a pager to eng-oncall if enterprise-tier impact detected.
Tom R: Great. I'll draft the RFC with the schedule and the rollback playbook. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
